blocks.text: SCHEDULE: 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals MANILA, Philippines–Rain or Shine battled back from a 21-point deficit in the first half to take down Converge, 124-120, and gain a head start in their best-of-five series in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals on Tuesday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. Adrian Nocum, import Aaron Fuller, Jhonard Clarito and Caelan Tiongson played their role as expected, but the Elasto Painters got some boost as well from rookie Deo Cuajao and Mike Malonzo in securing the series-opening triumph.
